artifact.summary: Abstained: the specification gives only abstract-level statements. The explicit nonlinear coupled equations, the definition of generalized extreme channels, the gate-level circuit, and the role of the classical dits are all missing. Any Qiskit circuit would be fabricated, so no code is emitted.

equation_mapping.explanation: The convex decomposition of the target channel into generalized extreme channels is a classical optimization result. It determines the weights p_k and channels E_k, but the abstract does not define the E_k or the equations that produce them. Without these, no unitary circuit can be built from it faithfully. Random sampling of k is a classical step and is not part of a measurement-free unitary operation.
The diamond-norm tolerance is an error criterion for the classical design algorithm and for verification. It is not a gate-level operation, so it has no circuit counterpart.

specification_changes.change: Narrowed the scope to no implementation: no circuit is generated.
specification_changes.reason: The gate-level construction of generalized extreme channel circuits, the explicit coupled algebraic equations, and the roles of the ancilla qudit and classical dits are not in the specification. Producing a circuit would require inventing these details.

assumptions: The system and ancilla were assumed to be qudits of dimension d. They would need a qubit encoding for Qiskit, and the encoding is not specified.
The ancilla was assumed to start in |0> and be discarded at the end. This is unverified and was not used to build any circuit.
unresolved_issues: The explicit nonlinear coupled algebraic equations are not given.
The definition of generalized extreme channels is missing.
The gate-level circuit for a generalized extreme channel is missing.
The role of the classical dits and any mid-circuit measurement is unspecified, and dynamic circuits are not allowed in the target output.
The runtime scaling derivation (logarithmic in 1/epsilon, quadratic in d) is not available.
No public validation contract or instance parameters were supplied.
